copy.goal_mirror: You came here for energy, a stronger heart, and a real way back to fitness.
copy.band_line: A 47 isn’t a verdict on your health. It’s a starting line — and the rare thing is, we can see exactly where the line sits.

relativity.headline: The average person who finishes this assessment scores about 60. Your gap is 13 points — and none of them are about age.
relativity.sub: Those 13 points aren’t genetics, and they aren’t willpower. They are a few specific, recoverable things — and the biggest are exactly the goals you told us mattered most.

gap_trio.headline: Your lowest pillar by far
gap_trio.body: A high stress load is quietly taxing the very energy and focus you came here for. It is the single biggest drag on your score right now.

gap_trio.headline: Movement is the lever you are not pulling
gap_trio.body: Your activity sits low — and it is the pillar most of your goals route through, which makes it your highest-return change.

gap_trio.headline: The symptoms dragging on everything
gap_trio.body: Fatigue, bloating, and restless sleep pull down your whole score at once — and they are the felt signals your plan is built to address first.

highest_leverage.text: Your highest-leverage move: Activity & Fitness sits at 43% — and every one of your goals routes through it. Lift this one pillar and energy, a stronger heart, and a real way back to fitness all move together. That is not a coincidence in your results; it is the shape of your answers.

copy.strength_note: A note worth hearing: your Health Habits score is 90%. Whatever you have been telling yourself, this was never a discipline problem — you have a strong foundation, it is just pointed in slightly the wrong direction.

findings.headline: Your statin answer changed the entire review.
findings.body: Because you reported a statin and low energy, your plan does not get a generic “men’s health” stack. It specifically reviews CoQ10 — which statins are known to deplete — alongside heart-aware nutrient choices. This is the kind of interaction a one-size quiz never checks, and it is why your formula will look different from your friend’s.

findings.headline: Your energy problem isn’t a caffeine problem.
findings.body: Your low energy lines up with high stress and light activity — not a missing stimulant. So your plan works the actual sequence: steady the stress load, support deeper sleep, and ease movement back in, with nutrients chosen to support that chain. More caffeine would only paper over it.

findings.headline: Your daily routine shapes your formula.
findings.body: Daily sunscreen, limited time in the sun, and low oily-fish intake all point the same way — so your plan leans into vitamin D and omega-3 support rather than guessing. Your formula is built around how you actually live, not just your age and sex.
